cohort: The study included 127 patients with pathology-confirmed Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for singleton, non-anomalous, viable pregnancies.
finding: The Surgical APGAR Score (SAS) was found to be a poor tool for predicting ICU admission in patients with Placenta Accreta Spectrum undergoing cesarean hysterectomy.
followup_time: 72 hours post-operatively (for ICU-level care requirements prediction) and total postoperative length of stay
